facts.fact: 父亲把两个女孩指给她看："看看她们，不完美吗？整洁、干净、有教养、甜。"
facts.anchor: “Look at them.” He gestured. “Aren’t they perfect? They’re tidy and neat. They’re well-mannered and sweet.

facts.fact: "她们温柔善良，不说脏话，不打架；经历了那么多，也从不对人发脾气。"
facts.anchor: They’re gentle and kind. They don’t swear. They don’t fight. Despite everything they’ve gone through, they never lash out at anyone.

facts.fact: "规规矩矩的小姑娘"——他转回来对她说——"我和你妈一直希望有的那种。"
facts.anchor: Proper little girls”—he turned back to me—“like your mother and I had always hoped for.”

facts.fact: 父亲说他们明白这不由人选："你分到什么孩子就是什么孩子，只能尽力而为。"
facts.anchor: “We understood you don’t get to choose,” he said. “You get the kid you’re dealt and you do your best with what you’re given.

facts.fact: "可你能怪一个人吗？梦想、盼望那么多年，怀孕九个月都在猜想，结果拿到的是个平凡、闷气、懒散、不上心的——难免有点失望。"
facts.anchor: But can you really blame someone, after all those years of dreaming and hoping, those nine months of wondering, not to feel a little disappointed when what they get is plain, sulky, lazy, careless?

facts.fact: "但不只是这个……你知道的，还有'那个'。"
facts.anchor: But there was that… you know, that other thing.”

facts.fact: "你那时就没看出来吗？你身上有什么地方不太对。"
facts.anchor: Didn’t you see it, even back then? That there was something not quite right with you.”

facts.fact: 他把两个女孩并排摆在崖边、背对风："就站这儿摆个姿势，姑娘们。我们拍张照片，好让 Tammy 明白点事。"
facts.anchor: “Pose just there, girls,” he said to them. “We’re going to make a picture so Tammy can understand something.”

facts.fact: 他说：从第一次接这两个可怜无辜的女孩来照顾起，她就有一种压倒性的、想这么做的欲望
facts.anchor: you had the overwhelming desire to do this.

facts.fact: 他干脆利落地一推，把 Lucy 推下了悬崖
facts.anchor: With a quick, sharp shove, he pushed Lucy off the cliff.

facts.fact: 她以为自己经过订书机和锤子已经脱敏了，可听到一具小小的身体在底下的岩石上碎裂，还是毫无准备
facts.anchor: I thought I’d be desensitised by now, after the stapler and the hammer, but nothing quite prepares you for hearing a little body crack on rocks far below you.

facts.fact: 呕吐物立刻涌满嘴；她跪下去干呕
facts.anchor: Vomit flooded my mouth instantly. I fell to my knees and heaved.

facts.fact: 她喃喃念着："这不是真的，这不是真的。"
facts.anchor: “It’s not real,” I muttered, chanting to myself

facts.fact: 然后他把 Laura-Ann 也推下了悬崖
facts.anchor: Then he shoved Laura-Ann off the cliff.

facts.fact: 父亲说："这就是你想要的。你一直想要的就是这个。"
facts.anchor: “This is what you wanted. This is what you’ve always wanted.”

facts.fact: 最糟的是他说得对
facts.anchor: The worst part was that he was right.

facts.fact: 她一辈子都在拿自己和那些完美女孩比，还有之后每一个完美女孩
facts.anchor: I’d spent a lifetime measuring myself against those perfect girls, and then every perfect girl who’d come after.

facts.fact: "你满身怨毒。你装出一副好脸，专业、冷静，可任何有脑子的人都看得出来。"
facts.anchor: “You are so full of spite. You put on a good face, professional, calm, but anyone with any sense can see it.

facts.fact: "你的手指就搭在这件事的扳机上，随时准备扣下去。"
facts.anchor: Your finger rests on the trigger of it, ready at a moment’s notice.

facts.fact: 他在她耳边低声说："这栋房子里只有一个怪物，Tammy。就是你。"
facts.anchor: “There’s only one monster in this house, Tammy. And it’s you.”

facts.fact: 她心里只抓住一个念头："这栋房子。"
facts.anchor: This house.

facts.fact: "我们还在房子里。"
facts.anchor: We’re still inside the house.

facts.fact: 斧刃落下前她抓住斧柄，把斧头挪到他够不着的地方，放在自己身边
facts.anchor: I caught the axe by the handle just before it hit him.

facts.fact: 她抽着鼻子说："我不是怨毒，我是愤怒。"
facts.anchor: “I’m not spiteful, I’m angry,” I said between sniffs.

facts.fact: "有很长一段时间，我以为持续的愤怒能保护我、给我力量、帮我反击我对自己那些可怕的说法。"
facts.anchor: I thought for a long while my constant anger would keep me safe, give me power, help me fight back against the horrible bullshit I think about myself.”

facts.fact: "可我只是累了。"
facts.anchor: “But all I am is tired.

facts.fact: "关键是你。这些年的所有称赞、所有说你多善良多好的人。"
facts.anchor: All the compliments down the years, all the people telling you how kind, how good you were.

facts.fact: "从来不是她们甜或可爱，而是她们'有需要'。她们让你觉得自己被需要，像个英雄。而我不给你这种感觉。"
facts.anchor: It was never about them being sweet or cute, it was about them being in need. They make you feel needed, like some kind of hero. And I don’t.”

facts.fact: "抱歉我花了这么久才想明白。"
facts.anchor: “I’m sorry it took me so long to figure it out.”

facts.fact: "这从来都跟我无关——哪怕我有点希望它跟我有关。"
facts.anchor: “It was never about me. Even if I sort of wish it was.”

facts.fact: 她拉紧线结，说："再见，爸。"
facts.anchor: “Bye, Dad,” I said.
